crossRefs.note: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands. They set up God’s house as it was…
“Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due…
The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them…
According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds…

translations.web: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.
translations.bsb: so that all the skilled craftsmen who were doing all the work on the sanctuary left their work
translations.kjv: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
translations.asv: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they wrought.
